_comment: Chi danh sach KENH can tu dong cap nhat URL tu playlist nguon. Moi lan chay, chuong trinh so sanh URL cua tung muc voi nguon; khac nhau moi ghi lai.

_huong_dan.source_url: Playlist nguon. Chuong trinh tai file nay va doc cac dong EXTINF/URL tu do.
_huong_dan.groups: Danh sach group-title can theo doi. Kenh thuoc nhom nay moi duoc doi URL. Khac -> giu nguyen URL cu.
_huong_dan.match_by: tvg-id la cach doi chieu chinh. 'name' chi dung khi muc khong co tvg-id.
_huong_dan.verify: true = tai thu muc phat moi + 1 segment that truoc khi ghi. false = chi kiem tra Hinh thuc URL.
_huong_dan.playlist_file: Ten file playlist dich, nam cung thu muc voi chuong trinh.
